text:
$BTC held near $84,781 after nudging up 1.4% in the last 24 h, hitting a high of $85,273.65 before slipping to a low of $83,186. Volume sat around 16,893 BTC, pushing quote volume past $1.42 B.

$ETH crept up 0.84% to $2,701.98, with the day's range tight between $2,673.13 and $2,722. Trade flow was solid, about 264,391 ETH moved, giving a quote volume of $711.94 M.

$BNB edged higher 0.83% to $772, topping out at $774.48 and bottoming at $763.02. Around 93,923 BNB changed hands, translating to roughly $72.23 M in USDT.

All three tokens showed modest gains and stayed inside relatively narrow bands. Nothing wild, just a calm push upward across the board.

$MOVR went nuts, it jumped 75 % and its 24-hour swing hit about 54 %, which is more than twice its usual daily range.

$BTC barely budged on the big picture, up a hair at 0.12 % but its price band stretched to roughly 2.9 % of the price, a bit wider than the typical 2.2 % range.

$SOL slipped 1.2 % and moved inside a 4.9 % band, right around its normal volatility.

Just a quick heads-up on the wild swing for $MOVR and the modest stretch for $BTC.

$NVDAB is holding around 230.17 USDT, up 1 % on the session. It nudged up to a high of 232.49 before easing back, and the 24/7 flow pulled about 12.3 M USDT in volume.

Tesla's token, $TSLAB, slipped a touch to 356.89 USDT, a 0.819 % rise. The price bounced off a 357.49 high, stayed above the 346.36 low, and logged roughly 6.5 M USDT traded.

Cerebras got hammered, $CBRSB down 6.098 % to 180.62 USDT. The swing hit a 193.51 high, fell to a 177.89 low, and moved just over 1 M USDT in volume.

All three are churning nonstop, even when the traditional market's closed. No big drama, just the usual crypto-hour grind.

$MOVR exploded, up almost 80% to $2.16, trading between $1.16 and $2.19 with over $51 M in USDT volume. $WLD nudged higher, +9.3% to $0.535, its range $0.48-$0.57 and $78 M moving hands. Meanwhile $AVAX slipped 4.3% to $10.93, stuck in a tight $10.80-$11.53 band and still hauling $70 M volume. One's roaring ahead, the other's just losing a bit of steam.

$BTC closed at $84,322, up 1.42% on the day. It hit a high of $85,649 before easing back to the low of $82,956. Volume topped 17.6k BTC, pushing quote volume past $1.48 bn.

$ETH nudged higher to $2,692, a 0.50% gain. The pair swung between $2,656 and $2,738, with 282k ETH changing hands and roughly $760 m in USDT traded.

$BNB led the pack, finishing at $770.57, up 2.17%. It bounced off a low of $750 before topping $779, and 132k BNB moved through the market, delivering about $101 m in quote volume.

Watch the $BNB order flow as it tests the $780 resistance; a break could set the next short-term target.

$ETH/$BTC slipped 0.711% while $BTC itself dropped 0.513% over 24 h. Meanwhile the 20-coin basket nudged up 0.613%, meaning the average alt outpaced Bitcoin. So BTC's lagging the alt crowd, but ETH's losing ground against its own benchmark. Overall a modest tilt toward the broader alt set, with $BTC and $ETH both in the red. Nothing wild, just a small shift in relative strength.

$SUI is up about 4.4% at $1.16, and its 24-hour swing was only 7.3% versus a typical 11.1% range. That's roughly a third tighter than usual, so the price has been moving in a narrower band.

$ZEC popped 2.7% to $1,414, with a 7.4% daily range compared to its usual 9.4%. That's also somewhat tighter, the market kept it more confined than it normally does.

$QNT surged 26.4% to $281.55, but its 30.8% swing was close to the 36% it normally sees, so the range was basically in line with the norm.

All three moved, but $SUI and $ZEC showed the most constrained action. Nothing wild, just a tighter-than-usual day for those two.

$AVAX just ripped through a swing that was almost twice its usual daily range, ending the session around $11.43 after a 9.5% jump.

$BABY managed a noticeably wider bounce, trading near $0.0140 and up about 6.5% as its 24-hour spread hit roughly 10%, well above the typical 7.7% band.

$ETH stayed pretty tame, hovering at $2,679 with a flat-lined 0.0% move and a range only slightly bigger than normal.

All three moved enough to catch the eye, but only $AVAX and $BABY really broke out of their usual patterns.

Nothing wild beyond that.

$BTC slipped 1.19% to $83,180.68, after testing a high of $84,563.99 and finding support near $82,775.94. Volume sat at about 13,717 BTC, pushing roughly $1.15 B in quote volume.

$ETH dropped 1.29% to $2,680.26, having peaked at $2,748.60 before bouncing back to a low of $2,652.20. Trade flow was solid, with 314,843 ETH changing hands and $851 M in USDT moving through the pair.

$BNB fell 2.34% to $754.60, sliding from a top of $773.44 down to $752.19. It logged 126,272 BNB traded, generating about $96.2 M in quote volume.

All three majors retreated over the last day, with $BNB taking the steepest bite. Keep an eye on whether the lows hold as the market digests the pullback. Looks like a modest down-trend across the board this morning.

$BTC nudged up 1.55% to $84,330, hitting a high of $84,381.3 before easing back to a low of $82,563. Volume sat around 15,642 BTC, translating to roughly $1.31 B in quote volume.

$ETH sprinted 2.39% to $2,728.98, peaked at $2,735 and found support near $2,651.68. Heavy action with 292,266 ETH traded, about $786.9 M on the USDT side.

$BNB inched higher, +0.41% to $766.32, topping out at $773.45 and bottoming at $753.81. It moved 133,033 BNB, roughly $101.6 M in quote volume.

Watch the $ETH order flow around the $2,730-$2,750 band; any break could set the tone for the next session.

$ETH is nudging up 1.002% against $BTC, so it's gaining a bit of ground in BTC terms. Meanwhile $BTC posted a 1.634% rise over the last 24 hours. The 20-coin basket of top-traded alts moved even faster, up about 3.469%, leaving $BTC lagging behind the broader alt pack. In short, $ETH is tightening the spread with $BTC, but the whole alt crowd is outpacing Bitcoin's gain. Nothing wild, just a modest shuffle across the board.
